## Summary

Describe the change and its user impact. Link any related issues.

## Verification

Describe checks performed and any limitations. For UI changes, include relevant
desktop and mobile screenshots without secrets or personal data.

## Checklist

- [ ] Changes follow the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/sourcier/sourcier.uk/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Relevant checks completed and behaviour changes covered by tests, or not applicable.
- [ ] UI inspected with Playwright before and after changes, or no rendered UI changes.
- [ ] Changelog updated and deployment date checked, or no notable user impact.

Report vulnerabilities privately using the
[security policy](https://github.com/sourcier/sourcier.uk/blob/main/SECURITY.md), not in this PR.
